name: text-motion
description: Motion from text, with fixtures' stand-in engine in place of the optional helper (ac_textmotion::stand_in): it holds the start pose and moves the root in a straight line from the start key's root to the end key's, so the numbers can be worked out by hand. text.helper reports the stand-in, loaded. Keys of yours stand at frame 0 (root offset z 0.9450101) and frame 30 (z 1.9450101). text.fill with the playhead on 12 fills the gap 0-30: 29 AI keys tagged "text A person waves.", and frame 15 is halfway, z = (0.9450101 + 1.9450101) / 2 = 1.4450101. text.generate from 30 for 1 s at 30 fps covers 30-60: your key on 30 stays, 29 AI keys between, and a key of yours on 60; the stand-in holds the pose on 30, so frames 45 and 60 keep z 1.9450101. Raising the key on 30 to z 2.0 leaves both stretches as they were and says so for 0-30 and 30-60. Refused, leaving the animation as it was: an empty prompt (spaces and a line break), 20 seconds (over the 9.9 s range), generating from 0 for the default 4 s (0-120 would cover your keys on 30 and 60), a fill given only from, keys 0 and 5 or 0 and 60 (not neighbouring keys of yours), and text.helper's unknown action fly.

notes: made by the fixtures' stand-in, not the model
0-30: the motion made from text was left as it was; make it again (text.fill) to meet the changed key
30-60: the motion made from text was left as it was; make it again (text.fill) to meet the changed key
